MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub android releases [options] [command]

List the server's releases (current marked *); `releases current <id>` makes
one current (rollback)

Options:
  --json                  Print the releases as JSON
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  current [options] <id>  Make a release current — the rollback; asks first
                          when its versionCode is lower
